name: 14502 · Macedon, NY
findings: ZIP 14502 (Macedon) has 36 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (61%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 14502 (Macedon) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 14502 (Macedon) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 14% of all organizations here have no identified type.
